exposure: mandatory second opinion prior caesarean section
cohort: Low-risk pregnant women (Robson groups 1 and 2) delivering at a private tertiary hospital, with 941 deliveries in the pre-intervention period and 1107 in the post-intervention period.
finding: Mandatory second opinion alone had no statistical significance in reducing the Caesarean Section rate and showed no impact on pregnancy outcomes among low-risk pregnant women.
mod_finding: Mandatory second opinion alone had no statistical significance in reducing the Caesarean Section rate.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from May 2022 to December 2022 (pre-intervention) and May 2023 to December 2023 (post-intervention).
